reason: A is the more physically defensible proposal because interface-mediated dislocation activity and shear localization can plausibly govern a nanoscale FCC/BCC multilayer without assuming that its unspecified FCC phase is metastable to HCP. B is more experimentally explicit, but its central claims that enhanced SRO necessarily raises stacking-fault energy and produces a delayed FCC-to-HCP transformation are material-specific, not established by the cited evidence, and its heat-treatment/alloying comparison would confound SRO with other microstructural changes.
